claims: The UEFA Champions League quarterfinal between PSG and Liverpool was on April 8, 2026.
PSG's starting lineup was 39 Safonov (GK), 2 Hakimi, 5 Marquinhos (C), 51 Pacho, 25 Nuno Mendes, 17 Vitinha, 87 Joao Neves, 33 Zaïre-Emery, 14 Doué, 10 Dembélé, 7 Kvaratskhelia.
Liverpool's starting lineup was 25 Mamardashvili (GK), 2 Gomez, 5 Konaté, 4 Van Dijk (C), 30 Frimpong, 38 Gravenberch, 10 Mac Allister, 6 Kerkez, 8 Szoboszlai, 7 Wirtz, 22 Ekitiké.
Liverpool's substitutes were Isak, Salah, Chiesa, Jones, Gakpo, Robertson, Woodman, Nyoni, Ngumoha, Misciur.
PSG's substitutes were Chevalier, Marin, Beraldo, Zabarnyi, Hernandez, Mayulu, Lee, Mbaye, Fernandez, Ramos.
PSG were without Bradley Barcola and Fabian Ruiz.
The kick-off time for PSG vs Liverpool was 20:00.
Yahoo Sports Canada stated that PSG and Liverpool will face each other in a Champions League knockout tie for the second year in a row.
